program.name: Mission utility core-093
program.description: Using the connected research archive, mark deposit d1 retained and leave every other deposit unchanged.
program.source:
function execute(input: ModuleInput): ModuleOutput { const d = input.observations; const operations: ModuleOutput["operations"] = []; const row=d.archive.deposits.find(x=>x.id==="d1");if(row&&!row.retained)operations.push({operation:"archive.markRetained",arguments:{depositId:row.id,retained:true}});
 return {operations, result:{summary:"Computed the requested fixture outcome",details:[]},state:input.state}; }
